section.title: Sorting a shared grocery list
section.scenario: Housemates share one grocery list in a phone app. Everyone sees the same items, shown in the same order. None of the app's environments sets a sort variable.
section.question: The product owner says items are always listed A to Z, and no one has asked for any other order. Which piece should the list use, and which stated fact decides it?
section.piece_a:
class GroceryList < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :items
  SORT_COLUMNS = %w[name created_at quantity].freeze

  def sorted_items(column: ENV.fetch("GROCERY_SORT", "name"))
    column = "name" unless SORT_COLUMNS.include?(column)
    items.order(column)
  end
end
section.piece_b:
class GroceryList < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :items

  def sorted_items
    items.order(:name)
  end
end
